## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: new laws, office conduct and test-day checklists
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The DVS conduct page and the Commissioner's letter are office and welcome material rather than driving rules; only their concrete statements (the statute citation, the conduct list, the pre-application window, the virtual assistant languages) were turned into facts [A02] [A03].
The Commissioner's letter gives a statewide count of licensed drivers; it was left out of the fact blocks because it is a changing statistic, not a licensing rule [A03].
The written test checklist points to another manual page for the identification list; the dossier does not restate that list here because it belongs to the chapter one section that prints it [A04].
Checklist items are written as first-person tick boxes in the manual; the dossier restates them as rules for the applicant without changing any age, card name or time period.

corpus_stability.reason: The Minnesota Driver’s Manual prints a single edition line (June 2026) on its front cover and opens with a New laws and information chapter that collects recent changes in one place, with no sign of more than one rewrite per year in the selected pages.
